lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meridian Campus, 2148. A vault corridor with four inches of standing water and a door at the end that was sealed from the inside.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Whoever sealed it did it in the year the Quiet started, and did it carefully, and is presumably still behind it.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Nobody in Ash Camp has ever been in here. We had stories about this corridor and none of them had water in.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The atrium was full of documents in 2064. Every one of them is behind that door and nobody has opened it in a hundred and sixty years.
